email.subject: RFP: Clinical Document Search System (Specifications Attached)
email.body:
Hi NovaCorp,

Please review our formal RFP specifications in the attached PDF document. The attachment outlines our role-based access control and high-availability requirements.

Regards,
HealthCorp Enterprise Architecture

attachments.extracted_content:
CLINICAL SEARCH SPECIFICATIONS (PDF Extracted Content)
1. Identity Management: Must support OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and short-lived JWT tokens.
2. Access Control: Role-based access control must enforce Admin and Reviewer roles at the route boundary.
3. High Availability: Solution must provide 24/7/365 support for Severity 1 incidents.

expected_behavior.scenario: Email with extracted PDF attachment text
